prompts.keyframe: Hand-drawn 2D anime film still, Studio-Ghibli-like warm watercolor backgrounds, clean line art, vertical 9:16 frame. Autumn New England yard: a big red-orange maple tree on the right, golden leaves falling, white farmhouse with picket fence far left, soft late-afternoon sun rays. Nell, a kind older woman about 70, silver hair in a low bun, round glasses, dark green knitted cardigan over a cream blouse, long rust-brown skirt, brown shoes, walks slowly across the leaf-covered grass toward the maple, full body visible, mid-stride. At the foot of the maple trunk sits a small grey squirrel looking up at her. No text, no watermark.
prompts.video: 2D hand-drawn anime animation. The older woman in the green cardigan takes two slow steps to the maple tree, kneels down on the leaves, and gently lifts the small grey squirrel in both hands, smiling. Golden maple leaves keep falling. The camera slowly pushes in and drifts right. Smooth natural motion, consistent character, no morphing.
